children: Kuwait International Bank, rated A (stable) by Fitch, has mandated a USD benchmark Reg S sukuk.
The senior unsecured five-year fixed-rate issuance will come under KIB Sukuk Limited’s $1.5 billion Trust Certificate Issuance Programme, a special purpose vehicle incorporated in the Cayman Islands.

Citi and Standard Chartered are the banks mandated as joint global coordinators, together with Arab Bank, ASB Capital, Bank ABC, Boubyan Bank, Emirates NBD Capital, KFH Capital, KIB Invest, QNB Capital, Sharjah Islamic Bank and Warba Bank as joint lead managers and bookrunners.
A series of global investor and fixed income investor calls will commence on Tuesday 1, September 2026.
In August, the Kuwait-listed bank obtained final approval from the Central Bank of Kuwait to issue a senior unsecured sukuk for up to $600 million.
(Writing by Bindu Rai, editing by Seban Scaria)

title: Kuwait International Bank mandates 5-year USD benchmark sukuk
